verb: rears up on its tail, hooks with its claws and crushes in a bear hug
_assumptions: ASSUMPTION (the PRDs are silent on the giant sloth; Open Questions GS1-GS6): a temperate titan (big, defensive herbivore: it ignores you until you crowd or hit it); tier 40 between the woolly rhino (38) and the smilodon (45); stats a little above the woolly rhino (more HP and defence, slower); tamed as a pack animal and fighter (bag + combat), no saddle yet; real_length_m 12 = the roster's 2x of a 6 m animal; height 3.39 m to the top of the head on all fours = 1.75 m at the shoulder x1.6 house exaggeration (2.8 m withers), about 6 m tall reared in the tripod.
look: giant ground sloth (Megatherium) on all fours, 2.8 meters at the shoulder and 8 meters nose to tail, shaggy rufous-brown fur with pale cream shoulder and flank bands, a long thick tail, small head with a blunt muzzle, huge forearms that knuckle-walk on long curved grey claws
texture_prompt: shaggy rufous-brown fur with cream bands across the shoulders and flanks, darker legs, grey-ivory claws, matte
prompt: giant ground sloth, Megatherium, shaggy rufous fur, knuckle-walking on long curved claws, thick tail

clips.alert: Rears up into the tripod (hind legs and tail), throws its arms wide with the claws splayed and roars: the threat display
clips.attack_primary: Hooking claw pull: half-rears, the right arm reaches far out, hooks her and hauls her in toward its chest
clips.attack_heavy: Two-arm overhead swipe: up into the tripod, both arms high and held trembling (the tell), then both claw hands come down together through the front (bleeds)
clips.grab: The bear hug's windup: rears up with the arms thrown wide open
clips.pounce: The bear hug: lurches forward out of the tripod, the arms close round her and bear her to the ground
clips.pin_stab: The crush: holds her down under its chest in the hug and squeezes twice
clips.charge: The lumbering advance: upright on its hind legs, arms out, slow heavy steps that hits do not stop
clips.toss: The advance's finish: topples forward onto her, both arms crashing down
clips.feed: Rears into a low tripod, reaches high for a branch, hooks it down to its mouth and chews
clips.knockdown: Forelegs buckle and it rolls onto its right side
clips.sleep: Lies down on its belly with the legs folded and the tail curled round

tactics._about: ASSUMPTION (SP-MEGATHERIUM, owner's design notes 2026-10-31): a huge, mostly peaceful browser (titan: defensive, it fights once hit; brave/stubborn/loyal/docile natures stand their ground and rear into the tripod display when crowded, timid ones only flee). In a fight: the tripod display (alert) leads into the BEAR HUG (the pounce machinery: the grab windup under the ground ring, a short forward lurch, the arms close at the hit and a landed hug PINS her under its chest while pin_stab squeezes twice, x pin_mult each) or into the LUMBERING ADVANCE (a straight charge at a walk on its hind legs with super armour: hits do not stop it; on contact it topples onto her, toss clip, a heavy shove). Point blank: the two-arm OVERHEAD SWIPE (attack_heavy, x heavy_mult, bleeds, heavy shove) or the HOOKING CLAW PULL (attack_primary: drags her primary_pull_m toward its chest). No leaping (leap_height_per_m 0), no hind kick (no kick clip). Every number is an ASSUMPTION (Open Questions GS3).
tactics._big_stomp: Hook for claude/mmo-bigstomp (not on canon yet): when its shared big-animal stomp lands, opt the sloth in with that branch's tactics key and a tools/gait/big_stomp.json row (legs: FrontUpper/FrontLower + FrontCannon/FrontFoot, HindUpper/HindLower + HindCannon/BackFoot; body Body, head Head, tails Tail1-3). Not built here.
tactics._knockdown: claude/mmo-knockdown (not on canon yet) picks the survivor's reaction from shove metres x size (height / 3 m = 1.13): the advance's 4.5 m shove = 5.1 = throw, the overhead swipe's 2.5 m = 2.8 = knockdown, the hook pull is a light shove toward it.

pipeline.inputs: ref/megatherium_tripo_{front,left,back,right}.png: Codex views from the owner's sheet (giant_sloth_owner_sheet_1) in a neutral all-fours knuckle-walking stance, padded to one scale; right = left mirrored
pipeline.rig_note: deer-style leg names kept for the shared tools: FrontCannon = the hand (wrist -> knuckles), FrontFoot = knuckles -> the claws, HindCannon = ankle -> ball (plantigrade), BackFoot = the toes; Tail1-3; ClawTip.L/R mark the fore-claw tips; Jaw

hit_parts._about: Where each move hits (the hitbox system is not on canon yet): at the clip's hit frame the named bones must be within radius_m of the target's body (Creature.part_hit). ClawTip.*: the fore-claw tips.
